quotes.quote: This release also adds GIF generation and photo markup in both ChatGPT and the API, plus SVG output support in the API.
The core safety stack we are using with ChatGPT Images 2.6 is based on the same safety foundations of ChatGPT Images 2.5
GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst includes multiple layers of image-specific safety protection.
we use safety-focused image classifiers designed to block potentially violative input images from being fed into the final generation
we use a safety reasoning model as a monitor to moderate both image inputs to the image generation model and the generated output
GIF generation introduces risks that may not be apparent in individual still images, including sexualized movement and harmful meaning conveyed across frames.
we apply safeguards designed to detect and block policy-violating GIF content.
We evaluated these safeguards using a targeted set of adversarial GIFs labeled as policy-violating. These challenging cases are not representative of typical user requests or outputs.
Recall measures the proportion of … violating GIFs in this evaluation set that the evaluated safeguards detected.
It does not estimate how often harmful requests are fulfilled or harmful GIFs reach users in production.
Motion-related violations remain challenging to detect, and the safeguards may not catch all violations.
Policy GIF Moderation Recall Overall 77.7% Sexual 77.8% Hate / abuse 90.9% Violence / gore 89.7% Extremism 92.9% Self-harm 77.5% Violent Activities 96.6%
We’re introducing Images 2.6 in ChatGPT, Codex, and the API, bringing your ideas to life faster. With this, you can bring motion to your images with GIFs
Images 2.6 is available globally today in ChatGPT and Codex across all subscription tiers on desktop, mobile, and web.
Learn more about our safety evaluations and safeguards for Images 2.6 in the system card

In a test of 310 policy-violating GIFs, the safeguards detected 77.66% of cases; the company cautions that motion-related violations remain difficult to detect and that the result does not represent production frequency.
